name: Scroll Speed
description:
Set the scroll speed, the setting GNOME does not have: mouse wheel, two-finger scrolling on the touchpad and middle-button scrolling on a pointing stick, each slower or faster. The wheel also gets a separate horizontal speed and optional acceleration when it spins fast. Works in every application, Wayland and X11 alike.

A compositor hands scroll events to applications before an extension can touch them, so the speed is changed where the events come from: a small Python helper (standard library only, bundled) reads the device and replays it through a virtual one with the scrolling rescaled. This needs one authorization, asked from the preferences, which installs a udev rule giving your session access to mice, touchpads and /dev/uinput (never to keyboards).
